unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 5 - Persuasive CAT and Publish - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. The Term 4 persuasive writing CAT over two sessions (Wednesday and Thursday), then a student-published good copy on Friday. Monday is pupil free and Tuesday is Cup Day. Replaces the four-session Polish and Publish plan (t4w5_lit_persuasive_writing.json).

lessons.title: CAT Day 1: Choose, Plan, Write
lessons.focus: Explain the CAT, check what a ready plan looks like, then 40 minutes of independent planning and writing. Critical feature: a contention that answers the question, held up by three different reasons. Retrieves: Week 4 Claim it / Prove it / Sell it.

lessons.title: CAT Day 2: Finish, Check, Hand In
lessons.focus: Finish the body paragraphs and conclusion independently, then the page 6 read-aloud check and hand-in for Elastik. Critical feature: the conclusion restates and sells, with no new reason. Retrieves: Week 4 Session 3 conclusions.

lessons.title: Publish Day: Polish and Publish
lessons.focus: Polish four common slips, choose a title, then publish a good copy to go home with the CAT. Critical feature: read each sentence slowly as you copy it. Not marked.
